notes:
Desktop v5.0.52

  • Fixed close dialog "Quit" button — now properly stops servers and exits application
  • Removed GitHub token initialization from main() — token now passed explicitly to update checker
  • Updated version to 5.0.52 across all build files
  • Removed unused Base64 import from UpdateChecker

Desktop v5.0.51

  • Fixed window dragging jitter in TitleBar — pixel-perfect drag gestures
  • Fixed FilePicker deadlock — rewritten as proper suspend function with Dispatchers.IO
  • Server folders now use sanitized server name instead of UUID (with UUID fallback)
  • Native Windows file dialog enabled via awt.fileDialog.useNativeLF

Desktop v5.0.50

  • Major UI overhaul with Material3 design
  • New server creation wizard with 6-step guided setup
  • Real-time console with color-coded output and command history
  • Player management: ban, kick, whitelist, op/de-op
  • World import/export (ZIP), plugin/mod/datapack management
  • System tray integration with quick actions
  • Automatic JDK detection and installation (Adoptium)
  • Multi-version support: Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Purpur, Folia, Vanilla

Android v5.0.30

  • Initial Android release — Minecraft Java Edition server manager for mobile
  • Background server hosting via foreground service with live notification
  • Full server management: create, start, stop, delete servers
  • 6-step server creation wizard with Paper/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge/Purpur/Folia/Vanilla
  • Player management: online players, whitelist, operators, banned players/IPs
  • Real-time console with log levels, search, command history
  • Performance charts: CPU%, RAM, TPS history
  • playit.gg tunnel integration for public access
  • RCON remote console support
  • World/plugin/mod/datapack/backup management
  • Automatic JDK installation (Adoptium)
  • Device-aware RAM/GC configuration
  • Battery optimization exemption
  • Dark/Light theme support

Desktop v5.0.25

  • Custom WiX installer template with uninstall shortcut
  • Self-locating uninstaller batch script in install folder
  • Update checker with GitHub API fallback to HTML scraping
  • Release tag regex handles suffixes like -desktop
  • GitHub token support for private repo access

Desktop v5.0.20

  • Compose Multiplatform migration from Swing
  • Kotlin Multiplatform project structure (common/desktop)
  • ServerManager with sanitized folder names
